extName.message: Enhancer for Plane — Projects, Wiki & Issues
extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and browser.

extDesc.message: Tweaks for Plane (makeplane/plane.so) — open-source project management, issues & wiki. Title/body templates + width rules.
extDesc.description: Short description shown in the Chrome Web Store.

optTagline.message: Body templates & style rules for Plane — the open-source project management, issues & wiki tool (makeplane / plane.so).

optDomainsDesc.message: Runs only on the domains listed below. One per line. Wildcards like *.example.com are supported. Saving prompts Chrome to grant access to each newly added domain.

optDomainsAll.message: Run on all sites (ignore the list below)

optDomainsTip.message: Tip: to enable the current tab's Plane instance, open the toolbar popup and click “Enable on this site.”

optRulesDesc.message: Force a property : value onto any CSS selector (with !important). If Plane's class names change, just edit the selector. Type the full value with units, e.g. 320px, 30rem, 55ch.

optRulesEmpty.message: No rules yet. Click “Add rule” to start.

optTplDesc1.message: Pick one from the “Template” button next to “Attach” in an item's description toolbar — it fills the title and the body together. The title is optional.

optTplDesc2.message: The body is written in Markdown and rendered into the editor: ## headings, - / 1. lists, - [ ] checkboxes, **bold**, `code`.

optTplDesc3.message: Variables (filled on insert): {{date}} today, {{date+N}}/{{date-N}} N days from today (e.g. {{date+7}}), {{week}} this week's range (Mon–Sun), {{month}} as YYYY-MM. Shortcut: Alt/⌥+T opens templates while editing a description.

optTplEmpty.message: No templates yet. Click “Add template” to start.

optTplShareDesc.message: Share with your team saves your own templates as a file your teammates can subscribe to. Host it where they can reach it over https and give them the URL — they add it under Template sync below. Templates you received from a source are not included.

optTplTitlePh.message: Title (e.g. [Bug] — leave empty to skip the title)

optVarsDesc.message: Values you can drop into any template — your own and synced ones alike — as {{var.name}}. A synced template can say {{var.team}} and resolve to a different value for each person who inserts it.

optVarsUndefined.message: The var. prefix keeps your names from ever clashing with the built-in {{date}}, {{week}} and {{month}}. A variable you have not defined stays visible as {{var.name}} rather than turning into an empty string.

optVarsEmpty.message: No variables yet. Click “Add variable” to start.

msgVarBadName.message: Use letters, numbers, hyphen or underscore only.

msgVarDupe.message: Another variable already uses this name.

msgVarLimit.message: Up to $MAX$ variables. Remove one to add another.

msgSrcLimit.message: Up to $MAX$ sync sources. Remove one to add another.

optSyncDesc.message: Pull shared templates from one or more URLs, checked on browser start, on a schedule, and when you open this page. Synced templates are read-only — edit them at the source. Host the file on the same domain as Plane to avoid a separate access prompt.

optSyncFormatDesc.message: A flat list; each item carries its own group string. The top-level name labels the whole collection and is used when you leave a source's name blank.

optBackupDesc1.message: Export all settings (domains, style rules, templates, variables, and sync source URLs) to a JSON file, or import a previously exported file. Imported settings load into the form — review, then Save to apply.

optBackupDesc2.message: The file lists your domains, source URLs and variable values in plain text — so if a variable holds your name, or those addresses are private, treat the file as internal. Synced templates are not included: they re-download from their source after you Save.

optStorageNote.message: Settings sync across your devices via Chrome, which allows ~100 KB in total. Templates are stored in blocks of ~8 KB, so any one template has to fit a single block.

msgInvalidSrcUrl.message: A source URL must start with http:// or https://

msgSrcEnterUrl.message: Enter a URL, then Save to sync.

msgSrcNotSynced.message: Not synced yet — Save, then “Sync now”.

msgChangedElsewhere.message: Settings changed elsewhere (e.g. the picker). Reload this page to apply them — unsaved edits will be lost.

msgLoadedPicked.message: Loaded the rule added by the picker.

msgFeedNamePrompt.message: Name this set of templates. A teammate sees it as the source's name unless they rename it. Leave empty to skip.

msgFeedEmpty.message: Nothing to share yet — add a template of your own first. Templates you received from a source are not included.

msgFeedExported.message: Saved $COUNT$ templates to a file. Host it over https, then share the URL.

msgFeedExportedCapped.message: Saved $COUNT$ templates — the most a synced source can hold — so $DROPPED$ were left out. Host the file over https and share the URL.

msgImported.message: Imported — review, then click Save to apply.

msgImportInvalid.message: Import failed: not a valid settings JSON.

msgImportNotOurs.message: Import failed: that file was not exported by this extension.

msgImportIsSyncFile.message: That looks like a template sync file, not a settings backup. Add its URL under Template sync instead.

msgImportNewer.message: Import failed: that backup is from a newer version (schema $FILE$, this build reads $HERE$). Update the extension first.

msgImportUnreadable.message: Import failed: could not read file.

msgSaveFirst.message: Save first — “Sync now” fetches the saved sources.

msgResetConfirm.message: Reset all settings to defaults. Continue?

msgSavedNoPerm.message: Saved — but site access was denied, so listed domains stay inactive until you grant it.

msgSaveQuota.message: Save failed: settings exceed the ~$LIMIT$ KB Chrome sync allows in total. Shorten or remove templates (or keep a JSON backup).

msgSaveQuotaItem.message: Save failed: your domains and style rules together exceed the ~$LIMIT$ KB Chrome sync allows for one block. Remove some, or keep a JSON backup.

msgSaveTplTooLarge.message: Save failed: the template “$NAME$” is on its own larger than the ~$LIMIT$ KB Chrome sync allows for one block. Shorten it, or keep it in a JSON backup instead.

msgStorageOver.message: — over the sync limit; saving may fail

msgStorageOverItem.message: — one block is over its ~$LIMIT$ KB limit; saving will fail

popNotLoaded.message: Not loaded here — reload the page (Ctrl/Cmd+R).

popNotLoadedShort.message: Not loaded here — reload the page.

popRescanOpen.message: Re-scanned. Open a work item's description.

pickHeader.message: Create a rule from a selector  ·  Esc to cancel

pickerHint.message: Click an element to create a rule · Esc to cancel

pickNoSelector.message: Couldn't build a selector for that element.

pickRuleAdded.message: Rule added: $SELECTOR$ — open Settings to set the value.

pickRuleFailed.message: Failed to save the rule (storage error).

optCopyDesc.message: On a work item page, the button beside its ID — or Alt/⌥+C — copies that item to your clipboard in one of the formats below. Use it to hand a work item to a chat message, a pull request, or a branch name.

optCopyTokens.message: Three values can be filled in: {{item.key}}, {{item.title}} and {{item.url}}. Everything else in a format is copied exactly as you typed it, so the preview under each row is what lands on the clipboard.

optCopyEmpty.message: No formats yet. Click “Add format” to start.

msgCopiedMissing.message: Copied, but $FIELDS$ could not be read — it stayed in the text as written.

msgCopyFailed.message: Could not reach the clipboard. Copy it by hand from the preview in Settings.

msgCopyNoItem.message: Open a work item's own page first — a list or a preview panel has no single item to copy.

msgCopyLimit.message: Up to $MAX$ formats. Remove one to add another.

msgCopyUnknownToken.message: Not a value that can be filled in: $FIELDS$. It is copied as written.
